title: Judge Superseded Rule Consolidation Response
description: Structured response from the superseded-rule-consolidation judge call site (#6 per spec §6.9). Fires when a tier-1 Violation references a legacy alias whose canonical rule has superseded_by set. Coach consumes this to embed migration guidance in the spawn-feedback for the next respawn.

guidance.description: Migration narrative referencing both the legacy alias and the canonical rule_id. Guides the next-respawn agent on how to migrate.

suggested_aliases.description: Deprecated IDs the agent is likely to encounter in cached training data. Listed under legacy_aliases on the Violation entry in spawn-feedback.

canonical_rule_id.description: Registry-resolvable canonical rule ID that replaces the legacy alias. Replaces the legacy alias in the rule_id field of the Violation entry.

fix_hint.description: Judge-produced remediation guidance. Augments or replaces the registry's default fix_hint for the canonical rule.
